children: Overview
US ticketing marketplace's Q3 revenue rose 7% yr/yr
Adjusted EBITDA for Q3 rose 84% yr/yr, margin up 10 percentage points
Company raised full-year GMS outlook after Q3 results
Outlook
StubHub raises full-year 2026 GMS outlook to $10.175 bln-$10.375 bln
Company reiterates full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance of $400 mln-$420 mln
Result Drivers
LIVE EVENT DEMAND - Consumers prioritized live events, supporting growth in ticket sales
BALANCE SHEET STRENGTHENING - Co extended term loan maturities, reduced borrowing rates, and repaid $100 mln in debt

The average consensus recommendation for the online services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Stubhub Holdings, Inc is $10.50, about 79.5% above its November 9 closing price of $5.85
The stock recently traded at 11 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 14 three months ago
